title: æ://draw
description: Deterministic drawing in video. The spec carries a shapes[] array; the producer injects it as ?shapes=<json>; draw-video.html strokes each shape progressively (the drawing gesture, not a fade). Primitives: line | rect | circle | arrow | polyline | polygon | text. Zero CDN, zero framework, zero ML.
pipeline: draw-video.html (spec shapes) -> CDP -> NVENC -> supervisionvidaeo -> VLC -> github.io
